verdict.what: a lighthouse with an attached keeper's cottage
verdict.style: Stone-based coastal lighthouse, medieval-to-rustic village style
verdict.looks: A tall round-to-square tower of white/light-grey blocks with two bands of red wrapped around it, stone-brick window surrounds with dark glass, a lantern room on top with a dark slate-like roof and small torches. A stone plinth at the base with mossy cobblestone patches and a wider stone step-out. Attached on one side is a small two-storey cottage with a brick-red roof, a stone chimney with a torch, dark wooden framing and pale plaster walls, and a wooden deck/fence on the lower level. The back view shows the tower leaning slightly and the same stone base; the right-side view shows the cottage's wooden frame and the lantern's railing posts.
verdict.summary: A convincing lighthouse with a readable stripe scheme, a mossy stone plinth and a cottage bolted to its base, with a few finish issues to tidy before placing it.
